subject.title: fix(grep): bound file reads with size cap in default grep operations

question: Should default grep retain the PR's fixed 50 MiB safety cap with no context for larger matched files, or should it preserve context through a bounded/streaming extraction design?
rationale: The patch removes an unbounded memory-read hazard, but it deliberately changes successful context rendering for otherwise readable large files; repository policy treats narrowed fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept capped degradation
options.body: Merge the current fixed-cap behavior: retain matches and degrade only oversized-file context through the existing unreadable-file output.

options.title: Preserve large-file context
options.body: Pause this PR and design bounded or streaming context extraction so large readable files keep context without an unbounded full-file read.

recommendation.title: Accept capped degradation
recommendation.body: Merge the current fixed-cap behavior: retain matches and degrade only oversized-file context through the existing unreadable-file output.
